candidates.summary: Latvia may finance the Sēlija military training area directly from its defence budget, avoiding a public-private partnership that could double construction costs.

candidates.title: Colder air moving into Latvia – rain, snow and frost expected during the holiday week
candidates.summary: Latvia faces a colder holiday week with rain, sleet, occasional snow, slippery roads and overnight frost, particularly in central and eastern regions.

candidates.title: Another explosion in Russia: former advisor to pro-Russian Ukrainian politician wounded in Moscow
candidates.summary: In Russia, a second explosion has occurred within two days, targeting individuals linked to the Russian army or pro-Kremlin politics.

candidates.title: Significant electricity price hikes expected in Lithuania
candidates.summary: With the rise in energy prices—most notably that of natural gas—Lithuanian households and businesses will feel a sharp increase in their bills.

candidates.title: Newspaper: Russia proposes removing NATO bases from the Baltic states
candidates.summary: Russia has reportedly floated unofficial proposals to remove NATO bases from the Baltic states and withdraw Finland from the alliance, according to Bild.

candidates.title: BNN IN FOCUS | "We have already made a whole series of decisions based on emotions" – Rajevskis warns of the cost of a grain transit ban to taxpayers
candidates.summary: Political scientist Filips Rajevskis warns that an emotionally driven grain transit ban could cost Latvian taxpayers hundreds of millions in compensation.

candidates.title: Ukrainian drone strikes Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland
candidates.summary: On the 11th of November, a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland was struck by a Ukrainian drone, forcing it to return to Saint Petersburg.

candidates.title: Latvia's Saeima Speaker wants MPs to use artificial intelligence to work faster and more efficiently in parliament
candidates.summary: Saeima Speaker Edvards Smiltēns proposes using AI to accelerate parliamentary analysis, alongside more flexible staffing and clearer committee objectives.

candidates.title: Outage in Microsoft services affects tens of thousands of users
candidates.summary: A large number of users worldwide have reported disruptions to the availability of Microsoft's online services.

candidates.title: Trump removes Vice President from handling the war in Iran
candidates.summary: The US President has called on his Vice President to focus on combating potential corruption in states and cities led by Democrats.

candidates.title: "You cannot bear what you cannot afford" – Latvia considers freezing Rail Baltica project
candidates.summary: Latvia may freeze Rail Baltica without sufficient EU funding, as Finance Minister Māris Kučinskis warns the country cannot afford its escalating costs.

candidates.title: Weekend plans may need to change – unsettled weather expected across Latvia
candidates.summary: Latvia faces a wet and windy weekend, with coastal gusts reaching 19 m/s, possible sleet and widespread rain expected next Tuesday.

candidates.title: Gallery: Estonian-built warship launched at Saaremaa shipyard
candidates.summary: The 45-meter EUROGUARD warship, built at Baltic Workboats' shipyard in Nasva as part of a joint project involving 10 European countries and 27 companies, was christened by President Ülle Madise on Wednesday.

candidates.title: Ukraine's Viktoria Motrichko retains women's world draughts title in Tallinn
candidates.summary: Ukrainian draughts player Viktoria Motrichko has won the women's international draughts world title match in Tallinn, retaining her crown after a 10-day contest.

candidates.title: Insurers have settled majority of Pärnu flooding claims
candidates.summary: Insurance companies have settled three-quarters of the claims filed following September's flooding in Pärnu. The downpour caused €8.5 million in damage and repairs are still underway in several locations.

candidates.title: Estonian agency decides country needs signature scent, spends €13,327
candidates.summary: Estonia is looking to make a lasting impression on foreign dignitaries with specially developed fragrances capturing the scents of its coastline, forests and bogs.

candidates.title: Tallinn to begin major tram track repairs in spring, wrapping up in 2029
candidates.summary: Major work to the tramlines network in Tallinn starts in spring, though while they are set to last to 2029, should not disrupt traffic unduly, Tallinn City Government said.

candidates.title: Minister: I understand Narva's concerns, but Estonia's security is more important
candidates.summary: Minister of Interior Igor Taro (Eesti 200) said he understands the concerns of Narva residents over the planned closure of the eastern border, but said the government must prioritize the safety of all Estonian residents.

candidates.title: More ambulance crews planned for Tallinn amid growing delays
candidates.summary: Tallinn Ambulance chief Raul Adlas says ambulance resources and hospital intake capacity have failed to keep pace with population growth in Tallinn and the surrounding region, contributing to delays in emergency care. The Health Board plans to add ambulance crews in the capital region in 2027 and 2028.

candidates.title: Flu vaccines run out already in some family medicine centers
candidates.summary: The flu vaccine arrived in Estonia later than usual this year, but some medical centers have already run out of doses. The vaccine should still be available at locations across the country.

candidates.title: Prosecutors: Minister retaining family doctor patient list not a crime
candidates.summary: A government minister who is also a medical doctor has retained her patient list, sparking scrutiny from the opposition and a review by prosecutors.

candidates.title: Harri Tiido: On the forces behind France's unrest
candidates.summary: In this installment of Harri Tiido's commentary series, the focus is on this year's unrest in France. Taking to the streets in protest is something of a national sport for the French and, incidentally, also a constitutional right. The constitution says nothing about looting, however, which falls under the criminal code, Tiido notes.

candidates.title: National Audit Office: Estonia on course to miss LULUCF first period targets
candidates.summary: Estonia is on track to miss its EU land use emissions target for 2021–2025, while its prospects of achieving climate neutrality in the sector by 2050 remain uncertain, the National Audit Office finds.

candidates.title: Analyst: Estonia's youth unemployment result of 20 years of 'efforts'
candidates.summary: Rising living standards in Estonia and restrictions on employment have contributed to the sharp increase in youth unemployment, SEB analyst Mihkel Nestor finds.

candidates.title: Estonian drone teams sharpen tactics with French, Belgian allies in Poland
candidates.summary: Estonian Defense Forces (EDF) members have been training in drone warfare with French and Belgian allies during an exercise in Poland.

candidates.title: Eesti Raudtee wants to preserve cross-border rail traffic
candidates.summary: The possible closure of Estonia's eastern border would not affect rail traffic. Freight volumes have shrunk to a fraction of their former levels, but railway company Eesti Raudtee believes the rail connection with Russia should be maintained.

candidates.title: Seto leaders: People want compensation if Russian border closed
candidates.summary: The Seto Congress has sent an appeal to the PM, urging the government to introduce compensation measures to support Setomaa, which would be adversely affected by Estonia closing its land border with Russia.

candidates.title: Estonia's €20,000 food robot set to relocate to Tallinn
candidates.summary: A Chinese-made food robot being tested outside a distillery is set to move to Tallinn, where it will serve hot meals around the clock, Maaleht reported.

candidates.title: Nationwide AI Week kicks off in Estonia
candidates.summary: AI Week (Arunädal), a nationwide initiative focused on artificial intelligence, will take place from November 18 to 22, with more than 125 workshops, lectures, discussions and conferences scheduled across Estonia.

candidates.title: Ratings: Center Party polls at 6-year high, widening its lead
candidates.summary: The Center Party has widened its lead in Norstat's weekly poll, while support for the fifth-place Reform Party also rose from the previous week.

candidates.title: Composer Sven Grünberg: Music should help people live and bring clarity of minds
candidates.summary: Sven Grünberg is a pioneer of Estonian progressive rock and electronic music whose creative journey has also been shaped by Buddhist philosophy.

candidates.title: Viljandi sacks official after local government's bonus points used for personal discounts
candidates.summary: The official has since been reinstated, but prosecutors have launched a criminal investigation to establish the circumstances surrounding the use of bonus funds.

candidates.title: Man 'steals' bus from driver in Tallinn, crashes it after driving off
candidates.summary: A man who attacked a bus driver in Tallinn over the weekend then stole the same bus, driving off with it and causing thousands of euros of damage to the vehicle after crashing.

candidates.title: Estonia unsure why number of people with disabilities falling rapidly
candidates.summary: The number of people with disabilities has fallen by more than 60,000 or nearly 40 percent over the past eight years. Neither the Ministry of Social Affairs nor the Social Insurance Board can pinpoint the exact reason.

candidates.title: Estonian homeowners call for right to leave expensive district heating networks
candidates.summary: The Estonian Homeowners' Association has criticized the government for delaying district heating reform, arguing that addressing the root causes of high heating costs would be more effective than subsidizing winter heating bills.

candidates.title: Minister rejects Ryanair's criticism of Estonia's aviation market
candidates.summary: Minister of Infrastructure Kuldar Leis has rejected claims by budget airline Ryanair that Tallinn Airport's fees are uncompetitive for the region, pointing to record growth this year and discounts for opening new routes.

candidates.title: Closing Estonia's southern border with Latvia would cost €65 million
candidates.summary: Restoring border controls between Estonia and Latvia would cost approximately €65 million, which would be better directed to the Police and Border Guard Board (ISS) and the Internal Security Service (KAPO), Ministry of the Interior Secretary General Tarmo Miilits has said.

candidates.title: Estonian goshawk may have spent winters raiding Russian poultry farm
candidates.summary: While migrating birds in Estonia usually fly south for winter, one goshawk headed north-east to Russia, where GPS data suggest it may have found food near a poultry farm.

candidates.title: Tallinn to increase road construction and cut officials in 2027
candidates.summary: Deputy Mayor Kristjan Järvan (Isamaa) said Tallinn will continue investing in infrastructure next year while cutting jobs in the city administration.

candidates.title: Estonian parties take different views on restoring border control with Latvia
candidates.summary: Estonian political parties are divided over whether to reinstate border controls with Latvia amid concerns over illegal migration and security threats.

candidates.title: Estonia's youth jobs paradox: Firms struggle to find workers
candidates.summary: Estonian employers report staff shortages despite high youth unemployment, pointing to a mismatch between the skills young people have and those companies need.

candidates.title: President: Closing Estonian-Russian border cannot be an emotional decision
candidates.summary: Decisions on whether to close the Estonian-Russian border must be made based on an analysis of the economic, humanitarian, diplomatic and security implications, President Ülle Madise said.

candidates.title: Estonia backs EU deportation center in Rwanda but won't join
candidates.summary: Five European Union member states are planning to establish a deportation center in Rwanda where people without a legal basis to remain in Europe could be sent in the future. Estonia supports the concept behind the pilot project but is not currently participating in it.

candidates.title: Hipodroomi intersection to open to traffic in both directions over winter
candidates.summary: The Hipodroomi intersection in Tallinn's Kristiine is set to reopen both lanes on Paldiski maantee over winter, and construction work will resume next spring.

candidates.title: Tallinn bar security guards sentenced to 13 years for robberies
candidates.summary: Harju District Court on Tuesday found 30-year-old Ruslan Hrapko and 26-year-old Vladislav Kirillov guilty of assaulting and robbing intoxicated people while working as security guards at bars in Tallinn's Old Town. The court sentenced both men to 13 years in prison.

candidates.title: Podcast host and author: Health is about more than diet and exercise
candidates.summary: The pressure to live a healthy, happy life can feel like a full-time job, but podcast host and author Kaidi Klein says balance and mental well-being are just as important.

candidates.title: 'Unicorn' caught on Saaremaa wildlife camera
candidates.summary: A trail cam on the island of Saaremaa captured the unusual sight of a "unicorn" – in reality a deer which seems to have a single antler in the center of its head, Maaleht reported.

candidates.title: Committee chair: Procurement rules broken in defense contracts
candidates.summary: The Riigikogu's anti-corruption select committee on Monday reviewed documents and correspondence at the Ministry of Defense related to Datasel. Many questions remain unanswered, committee chair Anastassia Kovalenko-Kõlvart said.

candidates.title: Artists' union re-elects leaders after falling victim to financial fraud
candidates.summary: The Estonian Artists' Association re-elected its previous leadership at an extraordinary general assembly, returning Maarin Ektermann as president and Tüüne-Kristin Vaikla as vice president.

candidates.title: Scabies cases surge across Estonia as treatment proves tricky
candidates.summary: Estonia is seeing a surge in scabies cases, with doctors warning that reinfection and treatment failures are making the infestation difficult to contain.

candidates.title: Estonia's men's football team finish 2026 with a win, beating Bulgaria 2–1
candidates.summary: Estonia beat Bulgaria 2–1 at home Monday night, ending the year and their UEFA Nations League Group L campaign with a win.

candidates.title: Illegal cigarette factory busted by police and customs board
candidates.summary: Eleven people have been detained by the police and officials from the Tax and Customs Board (MTA) on suspicion of large-scale illegal handling of tobacco products.

candidates.title: Dentist: No store-bought whitening product can actually brighter your teeth
candidates.summary: Store-bought teeth-whitening products may be ineffective or even harmful and people should consult a dentist before attempting to whiten their teeth at home, dentist Anasstasia Kuldmaa warns.

candidates.title: FM: More US troops needed on Europe's eastern flank
candidates.summary: Minister of Foreign Affairs Margus Tsahkna (Reform) said the United States' official plans will become clear by the beginning of winter, after U.S. outlet Bloomberg reported that U.S. troop cuts in Europe will be smaller than feared.

candidates.title: Tarmo Miilits: Russia is closing the Estonia-Russia border
candidates.summary: Estonia cannot allow Russia to use our openness against our own security, writes Tarmo Miilits.

candidates.title: Estonian basketball coach loses appeal over referee clash 5-game ban
candidates.summary: The Estonian Basketball Association (Eesti Korvpalliliit) has rejected an appeal from the coach of a top basketball team over a ban issued after an altercation with a referee.

candidates.title: EU packaging rules threaten to cut off Estonia from smaller European suppliers
candidates.summary: An Estonian lighting manufacturer urges the Ministry of Climate to address the problem of small European suppliers refusing to send goods to Estonia over EU packaging rules.

candidates.title: Risto Abel: The state should build roads, not apartments
candidates.summary: The government plans to build 1,000 apartments in rural areas to address a market failure. The problem is real, but the solution is wrong, writes Risto Abel. The state's role should be to create the necessary conditions, and developers will follow on their own.

candidates.title: Gallery founder: A little scandal helps sell art
candidates.summary: This autumn's art auction season in Estonia has been exceptionally successful, with more than €6 million worth of art already sold, says gallerist Siim Raie. In his view, scandals that have attracted attention in the art world have brought new buyers to auctions and helped boost sales.

candidates.title: New research method promises to shed light on Estonia's oldest steel finds
candidates.summary: New archaeological evidence suggests iron production in Estonia may have begun several centuries earlier than previously thought. University of Tartu researcher Kristo Oks is using modern chemical analysis and experimental archaeology to investigate the origins of Estonia's earliest iron and steel artifacts.

candidates.title: Migratory birds sticking around in Estonia as fall weather remains mild
candidates.summary: Some migratory birds are staying in Estonia rather than heading south this fall, as mild weather and plentiful food allow them to delay or skip their usual migration.

candidates.title: Researcher: Russia controlling the Americans in the Ukraine peace process
candidates.summary: Russia is calling the shots for the Americans in the Ukraine peace process, with Washington's desire to establish business ties with Moscow contributing to the situation, ICDS research fellow Marek Kohv said.

candidates.title: BLOGI ⟩ 1730. sõjapäev Ukrainas: Zelenskõi: Venemaa ei saavuta selle sõjaga ühtegi eesmärki
candidates.summary: 2022. aasta 24. veebruaril alustas Venemaa režiimi juht Vladimir Putin sissetungi Ukrainasse. Pärast seda, kui Ukraina lõi tagasi pealetungi Kiievile, on lahingute kese kandunud Ida- ja Lõuna-Ukrainasse. Postimees kajastab 1730. sõjapäeva sündmusi allolevas blogis. 2026/ukraina-kalender

candidates.summary: Eesti Loodusest ja Horisondist on huvitavaid teadusleide välja noppinud ajakirjade tegevtoimetaja Katre Palo.

candidates.summary: 🌔 «Sodiaagisosinate» uues episoodis kuuleb, miks nädal võib kujuneda küllaltki ärevaks. 🌔 Tutvume lähemalt asteroidiga Agamemnon (911). 🌔 Nädalat tuleb toetama Karikate neli.

Majandus- ja tööstusminister Liina Vahtras aga kardab, et taoline muudatus annaks ministeeriumidele liiga suure õiguse teiste asutuste tegevusse sekkuda.

candidates.title: Need märgid näitavad, et partner ei armasta sind tegelikult

Mõnikord võivad kõige sügavamad haavad tekkida hoopis sõnadest, alandamisest, pidevast kontrollimisest ja tunnetest, mida partner sinus tekitab. Vaimne vägivald ei pruugi alguses üldse äratuntav olla. See võib hiilida suhtesse tasapisi, nii et ühel hetkel avastad end olukorrast, kus kahtled pidevalt iseendas, kardad partneri reaktsioone ja tunned, et ükskõik mida teed, pole sellest kunagi küllalt.

Juba esimesest päevast alanud seletamatud hääled, kauboikaabuga varjud ja keset ööd seinast välja tõmmatud lambipistik sundisid pere lõpuks majast põgenema. Just neist hirmutavatest läbielamistest sai aga alguse Colini peadpööritav karjäär kummituste uurijana.
